settings.question: Are your mosaics weatherproof and waterproof?
settings.answer: Yes — every mosaic is fully weatherproof and waterproof, made from durable natural stone and glass. They're suitable for indoor and outdoor spaces, including pools, bathrooms and kitchens.

settings.question: What is the production and shipping time?
settings.answer: Each mosaic is handcrafted to order with a 4–5 week handling time, then transit typically takes around 10 days, shipped free worldwide with full tracking.

settings.question: Can I order a custom size or design?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Use our Custom Mosaics page to share your dimensions or your own image, and our artisans will hand-cut a one-of-a-kind piece tailored to your space.

settings.question: How are the mosaics installed?
settings.answer: Each piece arrives on a fiber-mesh backing ready to be mounted with standard tile adhesive. See our Installation Guide for full step-by-step instructions.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day returns policy and a lifetime warranty on every mosaic. Reach out to our studio and we'll make it right.
